thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - scale-controller: hotpath queue depth > 95th percentile, scaling lag detected. page fired to eng-oncall. details: queue.backlog=42k, avg-latency=1200ms, scale_rate=0.8x expected. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/scale-controller

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC-83721 triggered, urgent. Assigned to alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): Acked. I'm pulling metrics and starting manual mitigation. Anyone seeing customer reports? :eyes:

jordan (support): Getting a handful of realtime errors from customers in EU (timeout 504), some requests stalled in inference queue. Raising to infra SLA team.

maya (sre): Confirming metrics: hotcell-queue across cluster-3 spiked 08:02 UTC, node spinups queued due to quota bursts. Autoscaling controller logs show backoff loop: "scale_attempts=5 backoff=30s".

alex (oncall): Trying warmup override per runbook. sam, can you check quota/reservation and k8s node provisioning?

sam (infra): On it — cloud API returning sporadic 429 for instance create, looks like regional quota hit in us-west-2. Requesting ephemeral increase with cloud_ops. ETA ~6-8min.

maya (sre): In parallel: starting manual rollout to smaller model variant on hotpath routes to reduce per-token compute. will patch routing weights to 0.6 less expensive model.

alex (oncall): Pushed temporary routing change to canary. Traffic reduced to cheaper model for 20% of requests. Monitoring latency.

incident-bot: Note added to incident timeline: manual model fallback applied by alex.

jordan (support): Notifying affected customers: sending initial status with ETA ~15min for mitigation.

sam (infra): Cloud quota increase approved for short-lived surge, starting instance provisioning. K8s autoscaler still reporting "scale_throttle: true" until nodes register.

maya (sre): Warmup logs show KV-cache warmup in progress on new nodes. prefix-warmup hit 30% after node join. Latency dropping to ~700ms at 08:09 UTC.

alex (oncall): PagerDuty: acknowledged by alex, escalation to infra lead if not healthy by +10m.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded. Next escalation window at 5372468170.

maya (sre): Observability note: prefix-cache hit rate improved, request drain speed up ~3x. Queue depth trending down: 42k -> 9k over last 6m. Still watching for regressions.

jordan (support): Customers updated: follow-up message sent, no new errors reported since routing change.

sam (infra): Nodes are healthy and joined. autoscaler back to normal scale_rate=1.05. cloud provider noted temporary quota contention cause (internal ticket filed).

alex (oncall): Good. I'll leave manual routing in place until we see stable <1k queue and latencies <300ms for 5m. Maya, can you schedule a postmortem runbook check?

maya (sre): Yup — will open a postmortem PR and add checklist items: detect regional quota 429s, faster fallback to model variants, tighten autoscaler probe timeouts.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: queue backlog mitigated and autoscaler recovered. Closing page.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Short retro note: consider pre-warming nodes on predictable spikes and adjust cloud quota reservations for hot regions. :thumbsup:
